ud7.5:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud7.5:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā lakuṇṭakabhaddiyo sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
ud7.5:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ lakuṇṭakabhaddiyaṃ dūratova sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddasikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ yebhuyyena bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpaṃ.
ud7.5:3.1: passatha no tumhe bhikkhave, etaṃ bhikkhuṃ dūrato’va sambahulānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ piṭṭhito piṭṭhito āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddasikaṃ okoṭimakaṃ yebhuyyena bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpaṃti.
ud7.5:4.1: eso bhikkhave bhikkhu mahiddhiko mahānubhāvo. na ca sā samāpatti sulabharūpā yā tena bhikkhunā asamāpannapubbā.
ud7.5:4.2: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharatī’ti.
ud7.5:5.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi:
